# Introduction

Here, we convert RNAseq counts tables from featureCounts into a table of transcripts per million (TPM) for each gene.

## Steps to generate raw gene counts from Fastq files

These steps were previously run on the Genoscope cluster:

1.  Map fastq reads to reference genome using bowtie2

    \% bowtie2 -x \[genome_index\] -1 \[fastq file 1\] -2 \[fastq file 2\] -p 8 -S \[sam file\]

2.  Convert sam file to bam file

    \% samtools sort -\@ 8 -o \[sorted bam file\] \[sam file\]

    \% samtools index\[sorted bam file\]

3.  Calculate raw gene counts from bam file using featureCounts

    \% featureCounts -T 8 -p -s 2 -t gene -g locus_tag -a \[GFF file\] -o \[counts file\] \[bam file\]

# Functions

Counts to TPM

```{r counts to TPM function}

# Function to calculate TPM
counts_to_tpm <- function(counts, lengths) {
  # Step 1: Calculate RPK (Reads Per Kilobase)
  # Divide lengths by 1000 to convert base pairs to kilobases
  rpk <- counts / (lengths / 1000)
  
  # Step 2: Normalize RPK by total RPK per sample (in millions)
  # colSums(rpk) computes the total RPK per sample
  tpm <- sweep(rpk, 2, colSums(rpk) / 1e6, "/")
  
  return(tpm)
}

```

# Main

Load counts data, add sample descriptions

```{r load counts files}

samples = c("AA", "AB", "AC", "AD","AE", "AF", "AG", "AH", "AI");

# declare counts data frame
data_counts <- data.frame(
  Geneid = character(),
  Start = numeric(),
  End = numeric(),
  Strand = character(),
  Length = numeric(),
  Counts = numeric(),
  File = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# load data
for (my_sample in samples)
{
    counts_file = paste0(path_counts, "/", my_sample, "_counts.txt");
    data_in = read.table(counts_file, header = T, sep = "\t", skip = 1);
    data_in = data_in %>%
        rename_with(~ "Counts", contains("sorted.bam")) %>%
        select(Geneid, Start, End, Strand, Length, Counts) %>%
        mutate(File = my_sample);
    data_counts = rbind(data_counts, data_in);
}

# add annotation
data_counts <- data_counts %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = case_when(
      File == "AA" ~ "WT-1",
      File == "AB" ~ "WT-2",
      File == "AC" ~ "WT-3",
      File == "AD" ~ "S1-1",
      File == "AE" ~ "S1-2",
      File == "AF" ~ "S1-3",
      File == "AG" ~ "S5-1",
      File == "AH" ~ "S5-2",
      File == "AI" ~ "S5-3",  
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Optional: keeps unmatched rows as NA
    )
  )

```

Convert raw counts to TPM

TPM is calculated in two steps:

1.  Normalize raw counts for gene length (RPKM)

2.  Normalize RPKs for sequencing depth (TPM)

```{r convert raw counts to TPM}

data_tpm <- data_counts %>%
  # 1. Calculate Reads Per Kilobase (RPK)
  mutate(RPK = Counts / (Length / 1000)) %>%
  # 2. Group by sample
  group_by(File) %>%
  # 3. Scale RPK by the sum of RPKs per sample (in millions)
  mutate(
    RPK_total = sum(RPK),
    TPM = (RPK / RPK_total) * 1e6
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# print out table of TPM values for all samples

```

Output TPM values

```{r output tpm values}

tpm_out <- data_tpm %>%
    select(Geneid, Sample, TPM) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = Geneid, names_from = Sample, values_from = TPM);

write.table(tpm_out,
           file = data_out,
           row.names = F,
           col.names = T, 
           sep = "\t");

```
